heading: Learn one skill at a time
lead: Short courses that start from a real problem. Each lesson explains one idea in plain words, works through an example, and lets you check yourself before you move on.
principle: Take a lesson, then use it. Ten minutes of reading plus ten minutes trying it on your own code teaches more than an hour of reading alone.
outcomes: What you'll be able to do
noPrerequisites: Nothing. This course starts from zero.
related: Go deeper in the knowledge base
finishedTitle: You've reached the end of the course
finishedBody: Go back to the overview to see what you covered, or pick a related page and apply it to something you're building.

format.title: Same six steps, every lesson
format.body: You always know where you are and what comes next.

problem.heading: The problem
problem.hint: A situation you'll meet at work

example.heading: Example
example.hint: The idea, worked step by step

try-it.heading: Try it
try-it.hint: A small exercise to do yourself

teach.title: Teach what you know
teach.body: A course is a folder of Markdown files on GitHub: one overview and one file per lesson. Copy the lesson template, keep each lesson to one idea, and open a pull request.

home.title: Short courses, problem first
home.body: A few lessons each, ten to fifteen minutes apiece. Every lesson ends with questions so you know you've got it.
